title: Operational Specialization Profiles

selection_basis.strict_order: OARC-01 → OARC-02 → OARC-03 → OARC-04 → OARC-05 → OARC-06 → OARC-07
selection_basis.parallel_lanes: GPR-03 and MRCS-16 remain independently selected_not_started.

objective: Establish and validate the minimum source-backed profile data needed for ordinary vehicles, mecha, ships and bases to be playable through existing owner contracts, while leaving unsupported specialization facts unresolved and preserving future MERA/MBES boundaries.
acceptance: Define bounded specialization profiles for vehicle, mecha, ship and base using only source-backed normalized fields and existing owner hooks.
Distinguish common operational fields from type-specific profile data rather than forcing one universal stat block.
Keep mecha heat/energy/interface, ship life-support/hangar/FTL and base facility/habitation concerns as explicit source-backed profile fields or unresolved owner hooks.
Do not invent formulas, capacities, networks, subsystem topology or construction semantics to fill sparse source rows.
Profile validation must preserve OARC-03 mixed provenance and source-insufficient classifications.
MIB-14 remains operational configuration authority; PPIA-04/F014 remains vehicle/mecha/ship operational semantics; MERA/MBES remain reserved future runtimes.
boundaries: OARC-04 creates specialization profiles only, not a new operational runtime.
No engineering topology, dependency/failure network, diagnosis, disassembly/refit or acceptance-test runtime.
No construction, room/zone topology, utility network, habitation or settlement runtime.
No source-unspecified value becomes a default merely to make a profile complete.
GPR and MRCS lane state remains independent.
next_action: On an OARC-specific owner Continue, fresh-read OARC-04 plus OARC01/OARC02/OARC03 contracts, MIB-14/PPIA-04 specialization owner hooks and normalized representative source records, then execute the complete bounded specialization-profile tranche.
